# Shining Smite (`spells:shining-smite`)
**Level 2 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md) (Concentration)** | **Casting Time:** Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike | **Range:** Self
**Components:** V | **Duration:** up to 1 minute | **Classes:** [Paladin](../classes/paladin.md)
**Damage Type:** [Radiant](../damage-types/radiant.md)

The target hit by the strike takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage from the attack. Until the spell ends, the target sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius, attack rolls against it have Advantage, and it can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.

| Slot Level | Damage |
|---|---|
| 2 | 2d6 |
